problem: The production pricing browser gate clicked the loss lifecycle tab but the loss panel remained invisible even though the route loaded cleanly.
root_cause: Two pricing controllers owned the same lifecycle and plan state with different DOM semantics. The rescue controller hid inactive panels/cards using both the hidden property and inline style.display='none'. The inline controller only changed hidden. If the inline handler ran after or without the rescue capture handler, an active panel could have hidden=false while retaining inline display:none and therefore remain invisible.
prevention: Every controller that can own pricing visibility must apply the same complete state tuple: hidden, style.display, aria-hidden, active class, aria-selected and tabIndex.
Lifecycle and plan-group state must be idempotent across inline and rescue controllers.
Production interaction verification must wait for data-bg-pricing-interactions=ready-v3 before executing clicks.
A successful HTTP route check is not evidence that a toggle changed visible state.
LIVE_BEWEZEN requires the actual production browser click to expose the selected panel.

evidence.browser_failure: loss stage panel after click is not visible
